headline: Senior Human Resources Coordinator at Impala Platinum Ltd.

location.linkedinText: Krugersdorp, Gauteng, South Africa

about:
A proficient and conscientious Senior HR Coordinator (Psychometry & Talent) with skills honed over 12 years in the industry, Leanne Boshoff is a seasoned professional with a strategic mindset and solid work ethic and has historically shown strong initiative, drive, and an aptitude to excel. She holds a Bachelor of Arts (Honours) in Psychometry, as well as a Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Psychology, and is an expert in providing high-impact career development, performance management, and coaching to diverse talent pools. 

Presently employed as a Senior Human Resources Coordinator at Impala Platinum Ltd., she successfully spearheaded the establishment of a Psychometric Assessment department for the Implats Rustenburg operations in collaboration with her supervisor. Additionally, she has mentored and coached seven Psychology Graduates as part of the Implats graduate internship programme, as well as three Psychometrist Interns to complete their HPCSA Board Exams and register as Independent Psychometrists. Highly organised and structured, she is well-versed in managing the end-to-end performance cycle, executing talent management plans, supporting succession planning, and ensuring meticulous records maintenance.

With refined people skills and the ability to communicate spanning all hierarchy levels – Leanne is adept at providing on-demand coaching and team-building facilitation while promoting and maintaining high levels of engagement among talent pools and key stakeholders. With the ability to consistently meet high standards of work as well as strict deadlines, she is a valuable asset who is fully committed to the success of the company and its employees.

headline: Senior Recruitment Consultant

location.linkedinText: Brackenfell, Western Cape, South Africa

about:
Every successful project starts with the right people.

As a Recruitment Consultant at Smart4 Energy, I partner with engineering, mining, infrastructure, and energy professionals, helping them find opportunities where they can make a real impact while supporting businesses in securing the talent that drives their projects forward.

I enjoy getting to know the people behind the CV. Whether I'm working with a client looking for a niche technical skill set or a candidate exploring their next career move, my focus is always on understanding what success looks like for both sides and making the right match.

I recruit across a range of specialist markets, including:
- Engineering
- Mining & Resources
- Energy & Renewables
- Infrastructure
- Power & Utilities
- Project Delivery

I work with professionals across technical, engineering, project management, and leadership disciplines, supporting organisations from consultancies and EPCs to developers, operators, and mining companies.

I believe recruitment should be straightforward, honest, and built on genuine relationships. Clear communication, transparency, and taking the time to understand people's goals are at the heart of how I work.

Whether you're growing your team, exploring your next opportunity, or simply looking to expand your network within the engineering, mining, and energy sectors, I'd love to connect.

📩 Feel free to send me a message or contact me directly at G.Beeslaar@smart4energytalent.com.

currentPosition.location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
currentPosition.description:
Smart4Energy is a fast-growing provider of professional talent solutions to the global Energy & Resources sector. With offices in Cape Town, London, and Austin, we are part of the nGage Talent Group, a global talent business generating over $1 billion in annual revenue.
We are dedicated to delivering transparent, service-driven recruitment solutions and have a deep understanding of the entire energy lifecycle, from resource extraction and energy generation to financing, supply, and trading.
At Smart4Energy, our mission is to connect exceptional talent with industry-leading organisations across the global Energy & Resources market. We develop innovative, tailored talent solutions that support growing businesses at every stage of the energy transition.
Since our establishment in 2010, we have successfully placed both local professionals and experienced expatriates across a diverse range of energy and resources companies worldwide. We have supported clients in 29 countries, with a particularly strong track record across the EMEA region. Our leadership team brings more than 50 years of combined recruitment experience, enabling us to deliver specialist expertise and long-term value to our clients.
As part of the nGage Talent Group, Smart4Energy benefits from the backing of a global organisation with more than 1,000 employees, offices in 10 countries, and annual revenues exceeding $1 billion. This partnership strengthens our ability to expand our services while continuing to deliver the personalised, high-quality support our clients expect.
We recruit across Permanent, Contract, and Executive Search assignments and offer bespoke search and selection programmes tailored to each client’s unique requirements. Our comprehensive talent solutions support organisations throughout the entire project lifecycle, helping them build the teams they need to succeed.
Learn more at https://www.smart4energytalent.com/

about:
I am a Procurement Director and senior FMCG procurement leader with 15+ years of experience across Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Commodity Markets and Supply Chain, with a strong track record of translating procurement strategy into measurable commercial value.

In my current leadership role, I lead a 13-person procurement team, with responsibility for approximately £250m of annual procurement spend supporting 8 manufacturing sites. I manage procurement strategy and COGS exposure across a complex FMCG manufacturing portfolio, balancing cost, quality, service, working capital, supply continuity and commodity-market risk.

My category responsibility spans Agricultural Commodities, Ingredients, Packaging and Third-Party Manufacturing, covering both local and international sourcing. Key areas include commodity-linked raw materials, edible oils, grains and oilseeds, food ingredients, packaging materials and strategic supplier partnerships.

My core expertise includes Procurement Strategy, Strategic Sourcing, Category Management, Commodity Procurement, Global Sourcing, Supplier Relationship Management, Supplier Risk Management, Cost Reduction, COGS Optimisation, Contract Negotiation, Commodity Risk Management and Supply Resilience.

I work at the intersection of procurement, manufacturing, finance and commercial strategy, using commodity-market intelligence, supplier negotiations, category strategies and cost analytics to manage input-cost volatility and protect business margins.

My international sourcing experience spans Africa, Europe, Asia and the Americas, managing complex supply markets and supplier relationships across volatile commodity and input-cost environments.

As a procurement leader, my focus is not simply on buying at the lowest price. It is on optimising total cost, protecting COGS, securing supply, managing risk and creating sustainable competitive advantage.

I am particularly interested in the future of procurement and how AI, digital procurement, advanced analytics, commodity intelligence and procurement transformation will change the role of Procurement from a transactional function into a strategic driver of margin, resilience and business performance.

Core expertise: Procurement Leadership | Strategic Sourcing | Category Management | Commodity Procurement | FMCG | Food Manufacturing | Agricultural Commodities | Ingredients | Packaging | Global Sourcing | COGS Optimisation | Cost Reduction | Supplier Risk | Commodity Risk Management | Procurement Transformation | Supply Chain Resilience

location.linkedinText: City of Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa

about:
Most organisations don’t have a talent acquisition problem. They have a talent system problem.

I work with leaders to design it intentionally.

I am an Enterprise Talent Architect focused on how organisations build, structure, and leverage talent to drive performance, not just fill roles. My work sits at the intersection of workforce strategy, organisational effectiveness, and talent architecture.

Across global and emerging markets, and with experience spanning talent acquisition, talent management, and performance management, I have transformed talent acquisition from a standalone function into a strategic business lever embedded within the broader HR value creation system. This includes its integration with talent management, L&D, workforce planning, DEI, reward, organisational design, and overall value creation.

My approach is grounded in one principle:
talent is not a process, it is infrastructure.

I focus on cross-functional system build, designing how talent acquisition operates as part of an integrated system rather than an isolated function. This includes clarifying handoffs and dependencies across functions such as IT, hiring teams, and onboarding, and aligning people, process, and technology.

I design end-to-end talent journeys across recruiter, candidate, and stakeholder experience, supported by data-led decision making that improves hiring quality, speed, and business impact.

This has resulted in:
	•	Up to 40% reduction in time-to-fill
	•	85% optimisation of supplier ecosystems
	•	90%+ satisfaction across candidate and hiring manager experience
	•	Scalable hiring solutions across industries and geographies

Alongside my corporate work, I write and speak on talent, capability, and long-term value creation.

I am the author of The Talent Acquisition Manager’s Playbook: Building Strategic Influence in Your First 90 Days and Beyond, a practical guide on repositioning talent acquisition as a strategic, integrated function within the business.

I also contribute through HBR Advisory, Forbes BLK, and speaking engagements.

As a Career Catalyst, I extend this work beyond organisations, writing and speaking on both career strategy and how organisations design talent systems, while helping professionals think strategically about positioning, promotion, and long-term career capital. Through The Vase, I contribute to platforms that connect leaders and ecosystems to drive inclusive growth across Africa.

If you are building talent as a system, or rethinking how your career compounds over time, it will be a valuable conversation.

publications.title: The TA Manager’s Playbook: Building Strategic Influence in Your First 90 Days and Beyond
publications.description:
The TA Manager’s Playbook: Building Strategic Influence in Your First 90 Days and Beyond

Every day, high-performing talent acquisition specialists are promoted into leadership roles and expected to figure it out alone. They excel at sourcing, screening, and closing candidates, but leading teams, influencing C-suite executives, and driving enterprise-wide change requires an entirely different skillset.

This is the “Accidental Manager” syndrome, and it’s costing organizations their most promising TA leaders.
Drawing from 15+ years leading talent acquisition strategies across 23 countries, The TA Manager’s Playbook is the comprehensive guide I needed when I transitioned from specialist to strategic leader.

What’s Inside:
•	A proven 90-day roadmap for establishing credibility and delivering quick wins that matter
•	Stakeholder mapping frameworks that transform skeptics into strategic partners
•	Practical change management approaches for scaling TA operations in high-growth, resource-constrained environments
•	How to translate recruitment metrics into business impact language that resonates with executives
•	Strategies for balancing urgent hiring demands with long-term team capability building
Who This Book Serves:
This playbook is designed for newly promoted TA managers navigating competing priorities, team leads struggling to secure executive buy-in, TA specialists preparing for leadership transitions, and senior leaders committed to accelerating their managers’ success.
Why It Matters:
The shift from individual contributor to leader isn’t just about managing people. It’s about redefining your value proposition, expanding your influence, and positioning talent acquisition as a strategic business function rather than a transactional service.
If you’re ready to move from reactive to strategic, from overlooked to indispensable, this is your blueprint.

Available on Amazon in eBook, paperback, and hardcover formats. Print copies also available for direct purchase.

headline: I help CTOs, Tech Leads, Founders, and Heads of People to build high-performing tech teams that actually deliver.

location.linkedinText: City of Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa

about:
Hi, I'm Dave, husband, dad, founder, and someone who believes that great companies are built by great people.

I founded Swift Momentum to help companies build strong, scalable tech teams across permanent, contract, freelance, and team augmentation models. The hiring model matters less to me than getting the right people into the right environments.
I didn't come from a traditional recruitment or corporate background.
Before tech, I worked as a game ranger. The bush taught me most of what I know about leadership, resilience, trust, and people. Those lessons still shape how I work today.

I'm not interested in transactional recruitment.
I partner with founders, CTOs, and hiring leaders when:
• Hiring feels messy or overwhelming
• Growth is happening faster than internal hiring can support
• Timelines are tight
• Critical roles need to be filled properly, not just quickly
• They want a partner who genuinely cares about outcomes

Over the years, I've worked across software engineering, cloud, AI, data, product, QA, and technology leadership hiring.
I gravitate toward people who are sharp, curious, collaborative, and grounded. No egos. No heroes. No drama.
I'm incredibly proud of the talent we have in South Africa and firmly believe South African tech professionals can compete anywhere in the world.
Building a business has taught me that nobody gives you permission to start. You back yourself, take the leap, and build momentum one step at a time.
If you're scaling a team, exploring your next opportunity, or simply want an honest conversation about the tech market, I'd love to connect.

headline: Business Intelligence & Transformation Lead @ Roche | Lean Six Sigma - Agile Architect, Data, Digital, AI and Business Strategic Systems Transformation Coach

location.linkedinText: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa

about:
With over 25 years of experience in strategy development and transformation leadership, I currently serve as the Business Intelligence and Transformation Lead at Roche, a global leader in healthcare. At Roche, I focus on implementing SAFe methodologies, designing data-driven AI and digital strategies, and driving organisational resilience. My efforts also include enabling global SAP migration to a cloud-based environment, enhancing supply chain efficiency, and supporting global operations with advanced cybersecurity solutions.  

My core expertise lies in Lean Six Sigma, Agile methodologies, Data, Digital & AI Solutions, and change management, which I leverage to foster organisational transformation and improve decision-making processes. Dedicated to empowering teams and promoting inclusion, I collaborate closely with stakeholders worldwide to deliver sustainable, people-centered solutions that drive meaningful change in a rapidly evolving business environment.

location.linkedinText: South Africa

about:
I partner with high growth companies, BPOs and international organisations navigating complex hiring, workforce scaling and cross-border expansion.

I founded Believe Resourcing with the vision of building a recruitment and workforce business that combines speed, delivery and commercial understanding with a genuinely human approach.

Over the years, I have led large-scale recruitment delivery projects across BPO, technology, financial services, engineering and international growth markets, supporting organisations across Africa, the UAE, Europe and global remote environments.

My experience spans executive search, workforce strategy, RPO delivery, multilingual hiring, offshore talent solutions and international workforce expansion.

Beyond recruitment delivery, I have built and led recruitment teams from the ground up, including training consultants with no prior recruitment experience into successful talent delivery specialists operating across international projects.

Recent projects and delivery outcomes have included:
 - 13,700+ candidates screened within a six-month BPO expansion project
 - 550+ client interviews facilitated
 - 150+ hires delivered during large-scale growth phases
 - Global sourcing capability across 130+ countries
 - $650,000+ projected recruitment cost savings through embedded RPO delivery models

While I remain closely involved in delivery, my work today sits at the intersection of workforce strategy, international hiring and scalable talent infrastructure.

I am particularly passionate about helping businesses scale sustainably, build strong teams and unlock talent markets across Africa and emerging global regions.

-----Areas of Focus
 
Headhunting & Executive Search; Cross-Border Recruitment (US, UAE, Africa & Europe); RPO & High-Volume Hiring Delivery; Multilingual Talent (BPO & CX); Tech & Specialist Roles; Financial Services Hiring; Market Entry & Workforce Scaling; Offshore Talent Strategy; Employer of Record (EOR) & Global Hiring

about:
https://meethenriette.com/about
Cape Town property is one of the most attractive markets globally — but also one of the hardest to read from the outside.

Local and international investors often face the same challenges:
Where is the real opportunity?
 Which areas are overhyped?
 What is actually moving right now?
 Who can be trusted on the ground?
 How do you access quality opportunities early?
 
That’s where I come in.
I work with private investors, portfolio managers and international buyers looking to understand and access real estate opportunities in Cape Town.
 
My role is simple:
→ Identify high-potential locations
 → Filter real opportunities from noise
 → Provide grounded, local market insight
 → Connect serious buyers with credible opportunities
 
Cape Town is not one market — it’s multiple micro-markets with very different dynamics.
 
Understanding that difference is where the real advantage lies.
 
With experience in both the Dubai and South African property markets, I bring a global perspective with local execution.
 
If you're exploring Cape Town property opportunities:
 
👉 Send me a message with “CAPE TOWN”
 👉 Or connect and I’ll share my latest investor insights

Worked in the Abu Dhabi property market, managing the full sales process from initial client engagement through to final transfer.

This role required a more hands-on approach to transactions, including:
→ Managing property sales and guiding buyers through the full process
→ Handling transfer requirements, including NOCs from developers and body corporates
→ Coordinating with all parties involved to ensure smooth and compliant transactions
→ Attending transfers and supporting buyers through each step

A key part of this role was problem-solving in real time to ensure deals were completed.

One example involved  where I had to facilitating a transfer for a buyer who was hospitalised — working closely with an ADM officer to arrange signatures in hospital and complete the transaction under challenging circumstances.

This experience strengthened my ability to manage complex deals, navigate regulatory processes and ensure transactions move forward even in unexpected situations.

I was part of the development team, working on bringing new buildings to market once construction was complete.

My role was to step in at the launch phase — either for rentals or sales — and help get the building occupied or sold.

Key work included:
→ Managing the rental rollout for Ports Edge (conversion of the old Allan Gray building)
→ Leasing units until the building reached around 90% occupancy before handover to property management
→ Doing the same for Breakwater, working to fill the building with quality tenants
→ Working directly with tenants and positioning units in a high-demand area

I was also involved in the sales of Silo 3:
→ Helped achieve around 40% of sales before the official launch
→ Worked with both local and international buyers

This experience gave me a strong understanding of how new developments are brought to market, how demand is created early, and what makes a property attractive to buyers and tenants.

Built a strong foundation in the South African property market, working directly with buyers, sellers and renters across a range of residential transactions.

This role focused on understanding the full lifecycle of a property deal and developing a deep awareness of how local markets operate.

Key areas of experience included:
→ Advising clients on market conditions, pricing and property positioning
→ Conducting market research to support accurate property valuations
→ Managing property listings and presenting opportunities to prospective buyers
→ Facilitating viewings, negotiations and transaction processes from start to finish
→ Supporting the preparation and review of agreements and transactional documentation

Worked closely with a broad network of industry professionals — including lenders, attorneys, brokers and inspectors — to ensure smooth execution across each transaction.

This early experience provided a practical understanding of buyer behaviour, pricing dynamics and deal structuring — forming the foundation for working with higher-value opportunities and more sophisticated investors later in my career.

headline: Supply Chain & Operations Executive | Enterprise Value Chain Leader | Procurement | Manufacturing | Business Transformation | Building Resilient Businesses Across Africa

location.linkedinText: City of Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa

about:
Executive | Supply Chain | Operations | Business Transformation

Businesses create sustainable competitive advantage when strategy, operations, people and supply chains work as one integrated system.

That belief has shaped my career for more than 20 years.

I have been privileged to lead every major stage of the value chain—from international trade, logistics and customer service to planning, manufacturing, warehousing, distribution, procurement, strategic sourcing and enterprise transformation. This breadth of experience enables me to see beyond functional boundaries and solve complex business challenges with an enterprise-wide perspective.

Today, I lead Procurement and Finished Product Sourcing for Cipla South Africa, partnering across Manufacturing, Commercial, Finance, Quality, Regulatory and Supply Chain to strengthen supply resilience, improve cost competitiveness and support sustainable business growth. Throughout my career with Cipla, Aspen, Adcock Ingram, Hempel, Tate & Lyle and Safmarine, I have consistently focused on transforming operations, improving governance and building high-performing teams.

My experience includes:

• End-to-end Supply Chain Leadership
• Operations & Manufacturing
• Strategic Procurement & Global Sourcing
• Supply Chain Transformation
• Business Process Optimisation
• SAP & Digital Transformation
• Technology Transfer & Contract Manufacturing
• Inventory & Working Capital Optimisation
• Risk Management & Business Continuity
• Commercial Negotiation & Supplier Partnerships
• Executive Leadership & Organisational Development

I am passionate about creating organisations that are resilient, commercially competitive and operationally excellent. I believe Procurement should create business value, Supply Chain should enable growth, and Operations should become a strategic advantage rather than simply a support function.

My leadership philosophy is simple: build exceptional people, establish disciplined operating systems, make decisions grounded in data, and never lose sight of the customer and the patient.

Looking ahead, my ambition is to help organisations transform their value chains, strengthen manufacturing capability across Africa, and build businesses that deliver sustainable growth through operational excellence, innovation and empowered leadership.

I enjoy connecting with leaders who are passionate about strategy, manufacturing, supply chain transformation, operational excellence and developing the next generation of business leaders.

headline: Building High-Performing IT Teams in South Africa | Director & Senior IT Recruitment Consultant | Strategic Tech Hiring Partner for SMEs, Startups & Global Firms

location.linkedinText: Paarl, Western Cape, South Africa

about:
Hiring strong tech talent should not feel like guesswork.
 
I help South African SMEs, start-ups and growing tech teams hire the right people with more clarity, less noise and a far better candidate experience.
 
I’m Therese Otten, Founder of DataTech Recruitment. I’ve spent over 20 years in recruitment and business, with a strong focus on IT hiring across South Africa.
 
I recruit across:
 
 Software Development 
 DevOps and Cloud 
 QA and Testing 
 Data and Analytics 
 Architecture 
 IT Leadership 
 Infrastructure
 
I’ve helped growing businesses build their technical foundations and supported international companies hiring into the South African market.
 
My work goes beyond sending CVs.
 
I help clients tighten the brief, challenge unrealistic expectations, improve interview alignment and keep good candidates engaged before the process goes sideways.
 
Because most hiring problems are not caused by a lack of applicants.
 
They are usually caused by:
 
 unclear role scoping 
 salary misalignment 
 slow feedback 
 poor interview flow 
 candidates losing confidence halfway through 
 
I work best with businesses that want a proper hiring partner, not a pile of profiles.
 
The result?
 Better shortlists.
 Sharper interviews.
 Fewer wasted conversations.
 Offers that stand a far better chance of being accepted.
 
If you’re hiring into a tech team and want a more focused, more human process, let’s connect.
therese@datatechrecruit.co.za

location.linkedinText: Johannesburg Metropolitan Area

about:
Turning strategy into impact. Transforming supply chains into competitive advantage. Building sustainable value that lasts.

I am a procurement, sustainability, and business transformation leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, operational excellence, and purpose. As Head of Sourcing & Sustainability at Sandvik Mining,, I lead regional initiatives that strengthen supply chains, unlock value, accelerate localization, and advance ESG outcomes across Southern Africa.

Over the past two decades, I have built a track record of transforming procurement from a transactional function into a strategic growth engine—delivering commercial value, enabling digital transformation, developing high-performing teams, and creating sustainable impact for customers, suppliers, and communities alike. My experience spans global sourcing, supply chain optimization, mining and industrial markets, B-BBEE and localization strategies, sustainability leadership, supplier development, M&A integration, and large-scale business transformation.

I am passionate about challenging conventional thinking, leveraging technology and data to solve complex problems, and building partnerships that create lasting competitive advantage. 

Whether driving procurement excellence, shaping sustainability agendas, or leading transformational change, my focus remains the same: creating measurable business value while leaving a positive legacy for people, industry, and society.

location.linkedinText: South Africa

about:
I’m a strategic talent acquisition leader with deep experience designing and delivering recruitment solutions that scale across geographies, industries, and talent challenges. Over the last several years, I’ve partnered with global enterprises and high-growth businesses—building bespoke embedded solutions, executive search programs, and project-based RPO initiatives that go far beyond traditional hiring.
From building sourcing hubs across international markets, to running high-volume project RPOs, to supporting C-suite succession plans, my focus has always been the same: to provide actionable talent insights and deliver diverse, high-impact hires that enable business transformation.

I bring:
•RPO & Project Leadership– Designing flexible project-based recruitment solutions (short-term or long-term) for volume hiring, niche skill builds, or new market entry.
•Executive Search & Talent Mapping– Building diverse leadership pipelines, DEI-focused shortlists, and market insights that inform strategic workforce planning.
•Embedded Teams– Standing up and leading dedicated recruitment and research teams to partner seamlessly with in-house talent functions.
•Global Reach– Proven delivery across multiple continents, navigating complex cross-border hiring needs and diverse talent landscapes.
•Advisory & Insights– Providing salary benchmarks, location strategies, and market intelligence to inform critical talent decisions.
•Data & Dashboards (Business Clarity Projects) – A genuine data enthusiast who loves building dashboards, tracking insights, and transforming numbers into stories that drive better recruitment outcomes. I leverage this passion to help small businesses gain clarity on their performance through accessible, custom-built Excel dashboards (e.g., conversion rate analysis, revenue tracking). This is a limited-capacity, independent pursuit focused on making data-driven decision-making accessible to the small business sector.

Beyond my consultancy work, I serve as a director for Holmies in the Community NPC, a non-profit recently awarded PBO status. We focus on creating opportunities and supporting communities through training, career development, and volunteer engagement.

Whether it’s building a high-volume recruitment engine across continents, leading an executive search for senior leaders, or shaping the governance of a non-profit board, I bring the same values: partnership, transparency, and a commitment to outcomes that make a lasting impact.

headline: Senior Recruitment Consultant | Strategic global hiring & consulting

location.linkedinText: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa

about:
I may work in recruitment, but at heart I’m really just a people person who loves to play match maker and change lives.

I partner with both clients and candidates to strategically unpack the next step of their growth plans: for clients, this includes finding and placing exceptional talent that will take them to the next level; for candidates, this means finding them a role and company where they genuinely perform, grow and stay.

A lot of my work involves strategically recruiting for global companies, helping them build international teams with people who don’t just land the job, but actually thrive! In other words, I’m far more interested in long-term success than quick placements. Though I work best in complex, high growth companies, I’m a big believer in keeping hiring human. Profiles and job specs matter, of course, but through my experience I’ve found that conversations, relationships, and even gut feel matter just as much.

Having an Honours degree in Organisational Psychology, basically means I’m endlessly curious about what makes people tick! And I love being able to take that theory and use it in a practical way every day; understanding personalities, team dynamics, and where someone will truly do their best work and thrive.

In summary, I’m here to raise the bar in recruitment 😎

Beyond my professional life, I love to take full advantage of the beautiful city that I live in. From hiking to wine tasting… you can do it all in one day! You just won’t find me sitting for hours on the beach – sunscreen and sand don’t gel well with me. Where you can find me? Probably feeding my caffeine addiction by exploring the coffee shops in Cape Town to see who makes the best flat white!

One last fun fact: one of my favourite things to do is fatten up my friends and family, by forcing them to eat any and all baked goods that I create in my kitchen; I dare you not to love my brown butter & sea salt chocolate chip cookies!

At the core of his leadership is the ability to translate complex business requirements into procurement strategies that safeguard continuity of supply while maximising cost advantage. He has negotiated and managed strategic agreements with major OEMs and international vendors, embedding governance and supplier accountability frameworks to ensure both compliance and competitiveness. He is currently advancing toward MCIPS accreditation.

headline: I help remote job seekers stop being invisible to recruiters through visibility.  DM ME “Remote” for a free discovery call  Speaker | LinkedIn Optimisation, Corporate training, CV writer.

location.linkedinText: Pretoria, Gauteng, South Africa

about:
You're applying for remote jobs like it's 2014. Recruiters are hiring like it's 2026.

Mass-applying and waiting doesn't work as much anymore. Today recruiters search for people and they only find the visible ones. That's the gap I close. 

Here's how to start:

→ Join the Everyonely community
→ Enrol in the diamond  package — full training to get you started on your remote-work journey
→ Follow along — I share about my corporate journey, my clients stories and wins 🤭remote job tips, hacks, visibility, and real strategy you can use right away that’s what I mainly discuss 
Follow on Instagram: Everyonely_remotework 


🤝 Brand partnerships: everyonely.co@gmail.com

currentPosition.description:
I didn’t know I was in the business of building careers until people started trusting me with theirs.

For years, I found myself naturally guiding others sharing advice, pointing out opportunities, and helping people navigate professional paths without ever calling it “recruitment.” It was just part of who I am: someone who notices potential and wants to see it thrive.

The idea for Everyonely was born from my own experiences. I realized that myself and so many South Africans were missing out on opportunities simply because they weren’t visible globally. I started sharing what I learned online how I discovered remote work opportunities, how I approached applications, and what I wish I had known earlier. People became curious. They asked questions. Slowly, they started trusting me to help them take their careers further than they imagined.

Since then, I’ve had the privilege of working with clients who wanted clarity, strategy, and confidence. Together, we’ve transformed CVs, optimized LinkedIn profiles, prepared for interviews, and landed remote and global opportunities they never thought possible. Seeing people step into roles that truly match their potential has been nothing short of beautiful.

Everyonely exists to bridge the gap helping deserving South Africans step into global spaces, confidently and strategically. I’m also looking to connect with international and local companies to create more opportunities for talent to shine, because EVERY professionals are more than capable of thriving anywhere in the world.

Specialist Recruitment Consultant & Independent Talent Partner 

I am a passionate Talent Consultant with over a decade of high-impact experience, dedicated to helping companies from established firms to high-growth Tech Start-ups to source, attract, and secure quality talent in the most competitive domains.

I leverage this extensive background to operate as a strategic, independent partner, providing tailored recruitment solutions where agility and deep specialisation are required.

My expertise is highly concentrated in finding mission-critical professionals across:

Recruitment excites me because it's about connecting with brilliant minds and strategically helping businesses achieve their goals. I thrive on delivering exceptional and personalised service that drives tangible results:

•	Commercial Impact: I build solid teams of professionals who directly drive revenue, boost operations, and strengthen the company brand.
•	High-Touch Candidate Experience: I focus on building meaningful relationships, ensuring every candidate interaction is transparent, smooth, and empowering. This professional approach translates into higher offer acceptance rates and stronger employer branding for my clients.

Future-Proof Sourcing: Staying ahead of the curve
Driven by a thirst for knowledge and a curious mind, I continuously seek innovative ways to source and attract talent. I stay updated with new market trends and leverage AI-powered tools and HR Tech. This commitment to remaining agile ensures my strategies are always sharp and my partners access the top-tier talent the competition misses.

Specialties & Services
I provide end-to-end recruitment for roles ranging from Junior to Executive levels, including project-based recruitment and Fractional TA support for scaling teams.

Work-Life Balance 
Outside of work, I’m an adventurer at heart. Whether I’m hiking, cycling, or swimming in the ocean, Cape Town provides the perfect backdrop for the balance I need.

Let's Connect

about:
‼️ People. Purpose. Passion. ‼️

That’s what drives me-every single day!

With 11+ years of experience across Recruitment, Sales, Leadership, Onboarding, Marketing, and People Development, I’ve made it my mission to lead with heart, connect with purpose, and create meaningful impact. Whether it's nurturing long-term client relationships or identifying and empowering top talent, I’m at my best when I’m putting people first 🥇 

My journey has taken me through dynamic, people-focused roles. From Relationship Manager to Acquisitions Banker to Assistant Branch Manager- Each one sharpening my skills in client service, team building, onboarding, and business growth. But more than titles or targets, what fuels me is people-understanding them, empowering them, and building real, lasting connections 🫱🏻‍🫲🏽

Whether I’m onboarding new talent, supporting teams to exceed goals, or crafting seamless, personalized client experiences, I bring contagious energy ⚡ strategic thinking, and deep empathy into every interaction I thrive on identifying needs, solving problems, and helping others succeed: making me naturally aligned with both Talent Acquisition and Customer Success.

I’m not your typical corporate leader 💥I’m a believer in authenticity, a champion of emotional intelligence, and a constant student of life. I lead with logic, kindness, and ambition, always striving to create a culture of inclusion, growth, and excellence💎 My ability to read people and adapt communication styles quickly makes me a connector across every level and background.

Beyond business, my soul work is Animal Rescue and Rehabilitation 🐾 
I’m the Founder and Director of Rekaila Paws And Claws Sanctuary NPC- 2025/470952/08 a cause built from love ❤️, resilience 🔗 , and a fierce commitment to being a voice for the voiceless 🍃 Whether it’s saving an animal or mentoring a teammate, I show up with the same level of dedication and compassion🤲🏽

In everything I do, I lead with intention, uplift with purpose, and believe that a people-first approach creates real, lasting change 💪🏽

Let’s build something meaningful together 😁

Let’s connect!

currentPosition.description:
I develop and nurture strategic partnerships with organisations looking to build exceptional teams, while connecting talented professionals with opportunities that align with their long-term goals, values, and aspirations.

For our clients, I act as a trusted partner, taking the time to understand not only the technical requirements of a role, but also the culture, vision, and people behind the business. By building genuine relationships, I help organisations attract and retain talent that creates lasting impact rather than simply filling vacancies. 

For the professionals I work with, my approach goes beyond recruitment. Every conversation is centred on understanding where they are in their career, where they want to be, and how we can help them get there. Through honest advice, strategic career planning, and personalised guidance, I support people in making confident decisions that are truly in their best interests. 🌱

I believe the strongest partnerships are built on trust, transparency, and genuine care. Whether I'm onboarding new clients, identifying exceptional talent, or guiding someone through their next career move, my focus is always on creating meaningful, long-term connections that benefit everyone involved. ✨

about:
With over 12+ years of dedicated experience in IT, Technical, Digital, and Data recruitment. My passion lies in uncovering the "Unicorns" within the talent market, making it my mission to identify exceptional individuals who can contribute significantly to an organization.

I am currently the Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist at Cyberlogic, and my focus is to play a pivotal part in Cyberlogic's People Operations department. Responsible for the full recruitment life cycle, I guide the Talent Team and closely collaborate with Hiring Managers and other stakeholders. This involves cultivating a robust talent pool aligned with Cyberlogic's culture, managing various sourcing channels, and fostering trust-based relationships.

Previously, I worked as a Talent Sourcing Specialist at Capitec Bank, entrusted with sourcing top-tier talent for Digital and Technical roles. I also temporarily held the position of Acting Specialist: Talent Acquisition, where I provided specialized internal sourcing and support for our Digital and Data environment, actively engaging in the entire recruitment cycle.

Throughout my career, I have primarily focused on technical roles, from Mid to Senior and Management levels across the vibrant digital and data landscape. I strongly believe in the pivotal role that exceptional individuals play in organizational success and remain dedicated to securing the best talent.

What sets me apart in recruitment is not solely my talent identification skills but also my unwavering commitment to providing an outstanding candidate experience. Each interaction is an opportunity to leave a positive impression, recognizing the potential for future collaboration.

My focus remains on connecting exceptional professionals with opportunities that enable their success, thereby elevating the organizations they join in the ever-evolving landscape of Tech and Data talent acquisition.

headline: Founder | Behavioural Intelligence for Private Capital | Go-to-Market Operator

location.linkedinText: Wilderness, Western Cape, South Africa

about:
Two decades building and scaling companies, mostly in the space between sales and capital, and how systems make both predictable.

I started in tech, moved into sales early, and closed enterprise SaaS deals before leading commercial and data teams. Over time I learned what actually drives growth. It is not persuasion or pressure. It is qualification, timing, and trust.

Built and sold a tech company before 30, then led sales for the acquiring group. Since then I have worked across go-to-market, M&A and fundraising, helping founders and investors close hundreds of millions in transactions.

That work pointed at the same problem from both sides. People raising capital can't see who's actually deploying. People allocating it can't see what fits. SHV is the answer to that. headline: Director & Owner at Choice Sourcing | Comprehensive IT Monitoring Solutions For Businesses | I’ve Spent My Career Eliminating Digital Noise, Allowing Businesses to Focus on What Matters: Their Customers

location.linkedinText: City of Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa

about:
We should embrace the world becoming a more connected place.

More than ever, we can interact with businesses and people from all around the world. People can grow their small businesses into large ventures, families can connect across vast distances, and we can interact with people from different countries and cultures.

This connection allows us to live a fuller life by experiencing more of it. I embrace the technology that connects the digital world but also connects people.

I wholeheartedly apply these values to my lifelong career in building digital infrastructure and relationships with people.

During my time at Dimension Data, particularly after merging DNS into our networking operations, I became the Services Executive for Dimension Data SA. This position allowed me to oversee the services function in our South African infrastructure business. I focused on managing the local monitoring function and representing our region on the Global Services Advisory Board.

In partnership with Andrew Turnbull, we launched TeamSource, our outsourcing initiative, which marked a pivotal development in our approach to service delivery. 

This commitment to innovation and collaboration led me to start my own SaaS business. I have been a leader in IT monitoring systems since we began Choice Sourcing in 2002. We continue to be a top player in the market because we put the customer before the data.

We realised that traditional monitoring solutions, either in-house or outsourced, could be more effective and efficient. Both solutions need help differentiating between the noise created by their systems and the critical issues that need solving. These systems are about the data instead of the customer.

We have built a digital infrastructure that prioritises the customer’s business. Our innovative software suite focuses on cost and ease of operation to support the company. The emphasis is on scale, operational efficiency, self-healing, and change management rather than fancy functionality.

As a leader in IT Monitoring, I prioritise you, the customer, so your business can function and run smoothly.

Connect with me, and I’ll share our approach to innovation with you.

currentPosition.description:
Your Business & Technology Monitored by one Team on one Platform

We offer a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform designed to provide effective and efficient monitoring. Our approach combines technical expertise with a customer-centric mindset, prioritising business outcomes over technical metrics. This reduces unnecessary noise, optimises resource use, and delivers actionable insights, enabling businesses to proactively tackle issues, enhance service delivery, and foster growth.

Choice Sourcing understands that traditional monitoring solutions tend to be overly technical, generating excessive noise and consuming significant resources. Meanwhile, outsourced monitoring focuses mainly on service agreements rather than addressing customer needs, making it difficult to distinguish critical issues from unimportant alerts.

As the Director of Choice Sourcing, with my decades-long experience creating business network infrastructure solutions, we have our finger on the pulse of each part of the process while giving my team space to express their skills and use their experience to keep our clients connected.

headline: DC Talent Sourcer @ Microsoft | Talent & Diversity | Neuro-inclusion Advocate | Talent Acquisition Strategist | Candidate Experience Specialist

location.linkedinText: City of Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa

about:
I learned a quote early in my recruiting career that has always stuck with me - "my place in this world is to help other's find theirs". This is the bedrock of why I do what I do. My true north. It rubs shoulders with one of my (and many others) favourite African philosophies - Ubuntu - I am because we are. Knowing my why has been the foundation of my success - helping others find themselves in this world is my calling. 

Something I think it's really important for people to know about me is that I have a secret sauce - I am proudly neurodivergent. Being Autistic & ADHD is what makes me good at what I do - I'm passionate about spreading awareness and creating spaces in corporate environments for neurodivergent folk to feel safe and supported. 

With 12+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, I've built my career at the intersection of recruitment and operations, across both consulting and in-house environments - spanning Africa, North America, and Europe.
 
The first part of my career was spent at DAV, one of South Africa's largest recruitment consultancies, growing from individual contributor to national manager of the Engineering division. That consulting foundation set me up for the move in-house to BroadReach Group, where I started as a Subject Matter Expert and grew into a Talent Acquisition Manager role, leading global recruitment from our corporate shared services function. Along the way, I developed deep specialist knowledge of the public health and digital health sectors across Africa and the US. My work there blended TA operations with Centre of Excellence work - building out processes, SOPs, systems, policies, and capacity training from the ground up. In early 2025, I was retrenched following the loss of USAID funding.
 
That transition opened the door to working with Recruitism Consulting and Invisible Diversity, where I got to lean into projects aligned with my neurodivergent-led passions - a chapter I'm genuinely grateful for.
 
Today, I'm a Talent Sourcer at Microsoft, where I've supported hiring across Site Engineering in Czechia and Serbia, Microsoft AI Superintelligence, and now a Data Centre Project - helping build the teams behind some of the world's most ambitious infrastructure and AI initiatives.
 
Now you know a little (or a lot, I tend to overshare - shout out neurodivergent brain!) about me. When you're ready to share more about you, you know where to find me.

about:
I fix what breaks when companies grow, change, or hit a wall.
 
For 20 years I've been the person CEOs call when there's a gap between what they want to happen and what's actually happening — hiring that's too slow, leadership that's stuck, good people leaving, structure buckling under growth.
 
So I built Stellar to do what most firms won't: we don't advise from the outside. We embed with your team, do the work alongside you, and stay until it's fixed. And we price on outcomes — the bigger part of our fee depends on whether it actually works. If we can't deliver measurable results, we don't take the project.
 
What that's looked like: → A CEO wanted 50+ store openings a year. We connected property, design, recruitment, compliance, and operations into one delivery machine — zero compliance failures. → A CEO wanted to expand across SA, Namibia, and Botswana. We connected legal, payroll, operations, and local regulation into three-country operations — and the team won global HR recognition. → A CEO wanted a turnaround. We connected strategy, talent, and capability into an organisation rebuilt around new priorities.
 
To do it well, we built our own instruments — tools that make the employment experience visible and measurable, so we diagnose with evidence, not instinct. Our tools see what others can't. Our people do something about it.
 
How I work: I sit between strategy and execution. What's actually preventing delivery? What needs to change? Who needs to be connected? How do we build it so it holds after we leave? Then I make it happen — embedded with your team, not from the sidelines.
 
20 years across retail, engineering, pharmacy, and tech. Johannesburg-based, working globally.

publications.title: A framework for best practice supply chain management in the chemical manufacturing industry
publications.description:
The global chemical industry is gearing its readiness to pursue opportunities and protect itself from threats brought about by the 4th industrial revolution. The pressures brought about by the changing competitive business landscape within the chemical manufacturing industry give rise to the need to conduct targeted research into the principles that will underpin strategic decisions for supply chains entering the new digital frontier of business management. Qualitative research was conducted through semi-structured interviews. Saturation was achieved after 22 interviews with participants, specifically identified based on their skills and experience. Atlas.Ti software was used for analysis and the findings were recorded, linked to four main themes, namely supply chain challenges, supply chain priorities, possible solutions to these challenges and measuring supply chain success. These themes were informed by the literature study.

The study has comprehensively confirmed that collaborative, integrated, and highly digitalised supply chains are required to achieve a sustainable competitive advantage in the 4th industrial revolution. Additionally, organisations who fail to steer away from time-consuming bureaucratic decision-making processes and who fail to adapt their supply chains toward customer requirements will not exist in a meaningful manner in future.

#Supply chain management #Digital #Agile #Total Cost of Ownership #Chemical Industry #Best Practices #Challenges

During my time on the account I worked closely with my team to hire across the board from Sales, Tech, Marketing, Operations, and Customer Success. 

Notable achievements throughout the partnership include

- Decreased time to hire from 12 - 6 weeks 
- Reduced cost per hire and

location.linkedinText: City of Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa

about:
Ecommerce and business operations professional with 7+ years of experience across multi-channel retail, supply chain management, fulfillment operations, vendor relationships, inventory planning, and data-driven financial reporting.

I currently manage operations for a US-based artist merchandise company, working across 10 Shopify storefronts for high-profile talent clients in music, comedy, motorsports, and lifestyle. My scope spans ecommerce operations, 3PL and fulfillment management, carrier management, demand planning and inventory forecasting, multi-client royalty reporting, customer service operations, and building the analytical and operational infrastructure that drives commercial decisions at scale. I work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders across operations, finance, and commercial strategy.

I'm analytical by nature and execution-focused by habit. I've built tools and processes from scratch, from shipping profitability dashboards to demand planning models adopted by brand leadership, and I thrive in fast-moving, cross-functional environments where ambiguity is the norm and ownership is expected.

Outside of my primary role, I co-founded MHH Foods, a halaal frozen food brand in Cape Town, where I managed everything from vendor sourcing and production planning to B2B retail relationships and brand growth.

headline: Specialist Recruitment Consultant | Data, AI and Technology | Driving Growth and Talent Acquisition Strategies

location.linkedinText: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa

about:
I specialise in technology recruitment, working with companies that are building teams across data science, analytics, machine learning and software engineering. My focus is helping organisations identify and hire professionals who can contribute to complex technical environments and support the development of data-driven products and platforms.

The roles I most commonly recruit for include:

• Data Scientists

• Data Engineers

• Machine Learning Engineers

• AI Engineers

• Software Developers

• Data Analysts

• BI Developers

• Analytics Specialists

Technology recruitment is exciting because it sits at the intersection of innovation, talent and business growth. Every company today relies on strong technical teams, and connecting the right professionals with the right organisations can have a significant impact on both sides.

In my role I spend a large amount of time engaging with professionals across the tech sector, building relationships and understanding the kinds of challenges they are solving in their work. These conversations help me identify candidates who not only have strong technical skills but who are also aligned with the environments and teams they join.

I work closely with both candidates and hiring teams throughout the recruitment process, helping ensure clear communication and a positive experience from first conversation to successful placement.

If you work in data, AI, analytics or software engineering and would like to stay connected about opportunities in the space, feel free to reach out.

• Conduct market research and multi-channel outreach to identify and attract top talent. Build and manage candidate pipelines and talent pools within the technology sector.

• Run post-interview calls, ensuring alignment, gathering feedback, and managing follow-up steps including technical assessments and additional client requirements.

• Conduct opportunity alignment calls before offers, discussing salary expectations, motivations, counter offers, and career goals.

• Coordinate background, qualification, criminal, and reference checks to ensure smooth progression to offer stage.

• Maintain CRM and recruitment systems, keeping candidate records and interactions accurately tracked.

This role has strengthened my expertise in end-to-end candidate management, client engagement, and process coordination, while helping candidates navigate complex recruitment journeys successfully.

Jonathan Mphake from Eazi Access won the top award followed by Louw Riekert from Diraro Group in second and Edward Hoffmann from Tanker Services Fuel & Gas in third place.

honorsAndAwards.title: Silver Award For Supply Chain Innovation and Excellence and Environment Award for the Reduction of Carbon Footprint
honorsAndAwards.description:
The Logistics Achiever Awards awards ceremony recognises professionalism and excellence in the logistics field by rewarding companies in southern Africa for the innovation they drive in their own logistics and supply chain management practices.

Eazi Access walked away with the Silver Award for Supply Chain Innovation that delivered a customer-centric solution, and the Enviro Award for the redesign of fleet requirements and the implementation of optimised routing and scheduling.

Eazi Access received its awards for revolutionising its truck fleet distribution network. After thorough research and analysis, the organisation identified pockets of inefficiency and decided to implement a cutting-edge transportation management system to help streamline a customer-centric supply chain and logistics process – specifically its fleet of trucks that drive to its numerous customer worksites across the country.
According to Jonathan Mphake, Fleet Manager at Eazi Access and project owner, the decision to partner with Resolve was a natural one. “Resolve is renowned for providing tailor-made solutions that are innovative and practical,” he explains. “The way they streamline and optimise the entire operation brought people, operations, processes, data and technology together so seamlessly – making sure we could achieve the balance we needed.”

Supply chain innovation achieves operational excellence

The project design delivered several efficiency-focused features like a driver mobility system with real-time load status updates, integrated inventory and logistics; workstreams that increase productivity; and a continuous focus on information updates which are only some of the features the new system will bring to the network.

This greatly enhanced the way information and data were used to monitor the entire fleet and quickly act when a problem is detected to ensure maximum availability, maintenance and management of their trucks.

experience.description:
We empower talent for a sustainable future.

EarthStream is a global recruitment company specialising in three core functions within the energy space: renewables, power & grid and industrial technology.

Since 2010, EarthStream has delivered exceptional local talent along with experienced expats across a diverse range of energy companies around the world. With offices in London, Spain, Cape Town, Singapore, Hamburg, Dallas and Taiwan, EarthStream specialise in sourcing and placing outstanding local talent for each project. We work on a wide range of permanent and contract roles, along with designed search and selection programmes tailored for our clients’ needs that offer support services through the whole project lifecycle. We cover roles across the research, production, supply, distribution, and management of energy on a global scale, and are currently operating in over 60 countries.

We are part of the Xcede Group, a global recruitment organisation that delivers technology and energy talent solutions which enable companies to innovate and grow. Formed in 2020 by a merger of three well-established organisations TechStream, Xcede and Etonwood our mission is to attract the talent that is helping our clients shape the new global economy.

Learn more about EarthStream by visiting: https://www.earthstreamglobal.com/

My approach extends beyond recruitment; I possess a unique ability to mentor, lead, and train individuals within the industry. I am a Digital Transformation & Delivery Lead / Senior Programme Manager with 16+ years of experience leading complex engineering, technology, and operational programmes across telecoms, rail, infrastructure, and fintech. I specialise in end-to-end delivery, programme governance, data-first and automation-led transformation, analytics uplift, cost optimisation, and multi-country execution — consistently delivering measurable outcomes at enterprise scale.

My track record includes delivering R160M+ in annual OPEX savings, reducing a national asset-capitalisation backlog from R6Bn to R3Bn, and strengthening data and analytics maturity across energy, billing, leases, rentals, and consumption reporting. I have led the full lifecycle delivery of a €145M rail engineering and manufacturing programme, overseen global cross-functional teams, and directed initiatives resulting in €6.4M in sourcing impact and €1.5M in engineering risk mitigation.

In parallel to corporate leadership roles, I co-founded a fintech-enabled platform, where I shaped product strategy, operational and risk frameworks, SWIFT-aligned customer workflows, dispute-resolution processes, and helped secure a $100K enterprise client portfolio.

Known for disciplined delivery, structured decision-making, and clear executive communication, I excel at simplifying complexity, eliminating operational bottlenecks, and aligning large-scale programmes with business and commercial objectives. I thrive in environments where technology, data, governance, and cross-functional execution come together to drive adoption, operational excellence, and ROI.

As a Talent Sourcing Specialist at Capitec Bank, I specialize in identifying and connecting top tech talent with opportunities that drive innovation and growth. With a keen eye for emerging trends in technology and data, I am dedicated to empowering professionals to reach their career aspirations within a dynamic and forward-thinking environment.

currentPosition.position: Talent Sourcing Specialist - Tech & Data Talent Attraction
currentPosition.location: City of Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
currentPosition.description:
As a Talent Sourcing Specialist, I focus on proactively identifying and engaging top talent to support Capitec’s strategic hiring needs. My role involves a blend of research, relationship-building, and market insight to ensure we connect with the best candidates in the industry.

🔍 Identifying Talent Pools
Utilize a range of sourcing techniques—including online databases, professional networks, and referrals—to uncover high-potential talent across various domains.

📊 Market & Competitor Research
Conduct research to map the talent landscape, understand emerging trends, analyze competitors, and stay ahead of evolving skill requirements.

🤝 Candidate Engagement & Outreach
Connect with potential candidates through personalized outreach (LinkedIn, email, phone), introducing Capitec’s opportunities and assessing interest.

🛠️ Pipeline Development
Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified candidates for both immediate and future hiring needs, ensuring alignment with workforce planning.

🎯 Screening & Qualification
Perform initial screenings to assess candidates' experience, technical skills, and cultural fit, supporting informed hiring decisions.

🤝 Stakeholder Collaboration
Partner with Hiring Managers and Talent Acquisition Specialists to understand talent requirements, align on sourcing strategies, and share market intelligence.

✨ Candidate Experience
Foster meaningful candidate relationships, ensuring a smooth, respectful, and engaging experience throughout the sourcing process.

📈 Sourcing Analytics
Track and analyze sourcing performance metrics to evaluate effectiveness, guide continuous improvement, and inform strategy.

🌐 Industry Awareness
Stay current with sourcing tools, recruitment best practices, and talent market dynamics to continuously improve sourcing outcomes.

🌟 Employer Branding
Act as a brand ambassador, sharing Capitec’s culture, values, and employee value proposition to attract exceptional talent.

receivedRecommendations.description: Marisa is driven and draws from her wealth of expertise to produce quicker positive results.

receivedRecommendations.givenByHeadline: Senior Test Analyst at Bayport Financial Services | BML
receivedRecommendations.givenAt: February 24, 2016, Marisa was senior to Karen but didn't manage Karen directly
receivedRecommendations.description: I had the pleasure of working with Marisa who was always professional, engaging and highly motivated with a can do attitude. Marisa is extremely detail-orientated, an excellent communicator and her decisions were always in the best interest of her customers and peers. Furthermore, Marisa is easy to work with and able to offer a clear perspective on complex issues.

receivedRecommendations.givenByHeadline: CV Extraordinaire
receivedRecommendations.givenAt: October 28, 2015, Jolene reported directly to Marisa
receivedRecommendations.description:
I was one of the privileged few who had the opportunity to report to Marisa. Marisa being not just a leader, but a mentor. She recognises potential in each individual and will develop that individual to his or her full potential, getting the very best from each person. 
Marisa is a motivator and performance specialist. She commands respect and as a result her staff (including me) delivers results with dedication, devotion and passion. Managers and Leaders who strive to develop their staff as well as motivating them are few and far between - I consider myself fortunate to be able to say that I had the opportunity to work under her leadership and guidance. She contributed to me being the successful Consultant that I am today. I can proudly say that if you are given the opportunity to work with or for Marisa - take it. You will walk a path filled with a wealth of knowledge and be a richer person for it at the end of the day!

receivedRecommendations.givenByHeadline: NEM Energy Trading & Markets | BESS Strategy | Executive Leader | Clean Energy Transition | EGM-Level | Brisbane
receivedRecommendations.givenAt: September 14, 2015, Robert worked with Marisa but they were at different companies
receivedRecommendations.description:
Marisa found me and got to know me very quickly, she identified a key interest of mine that I was not pursuing. Marisa opened up my eyes to a new opportunity that as a result, I am the happiest I have been in a very long time. Knowing now what I know about my foreign employer, this was not an easy task for Marisa and it is a role I am loving. Thank you Marisa for looking beyond the CV and getting to know the reality underneath. It is an incredibly rare talent in recruitment and way beyond the normal CV check and chug.

You have a skill and I am very lucky to have been found by that skill.

receivedRecommendations.givenByHeadline: Director Africa Affairs at CANSO
receivedRecommendations.description:
My experience of working with Marisa was very refreshing and quite different from typical executive search professionals. She is articulate in the profession, patient and has an eye for detail. She is not easily swayed either, very focused in her approach and can be really creative and convincing in her style. 
Relentless in her pursuit, does not give up easily. Her approach to opportunities is calculated and strategic. She has an ability to manage the complex dynamics that come from the clients internal processes and balance these with the candidate's needs.. Lovely person to work with. 
I would recommend Marisa to any professional whether seeking to recruit or seeking placement.

receivedRecommendations.givenByHeadline: Co-Founder at AgNovate (Pty) Ltd
receivedRecommendations.description: I was privileged to be placed in my current role by Marisa. From my non-South African employer perspective I know in retrospect that the methodology required to create my specialist role and to recruit the individual involved unique methodologies with its own challenges. However, I experience a completely smooth recruitment process which filled me with trust and confidence. I later realised that I was not exposed to the unique challenges as mentioned. I contribute this to Marisa's professionalism in understanding her client's needs and her role to fulfil and execute. She displayed this special touch and commitment even after I took up the role by following up on my well being in the new role. Thanks Marisa!
